products.title: {nutrient}: price per {unit}
products.explainerLabel: How this unit price is derived
products.explainer.protein: A bag of protein powder is not priced by its net weight. Divide the price by the net weight multiplied by the protein content ratio printed on the label, and you get the price per gram of protein. A 1kg product at 75% carries 750g of protein. pergram refetches prices from each store daily and ranks by that figure alone. Content ratios come from the nutrition panel published by the manufacturer.

lp.features.eyebrow: How this differs from listicles and search
lp.features.heading: Why pergram exists
lp.features.problem1: Listicles only. You cannot tell where a product ranks across the whole market.
lp.features.solution1: Every listed product in one column, sorted by unit price. The lowest is first.
lp.features.problem2: Article prices are frozen at publication and miss later sales and changes.
lp.features.solution2: Prices are refetched daily. A sale price flows straight into the unit price.
lp.features.problem3: Most top-ranking articles are affiliate posts that do not publish how they rank.
lp.features.solution3: No in-house score. Rank comes from the unit price calculation alone.
lp.features.bannerText: Nutrient you care about not covered yet? Tell us which to add next.
lp.how.eyebrow: How the unit price is derived
lp.how.heading: Sort by pack price and the order flips
lp.how.lede: Two 1kg products with different content ratios do not cost the same per gram. pergram divides price by the amount of active ingredient and ranks by that figure alone.
lp.how.beforeSub: You pay less for product A
lp.how.beforeNote: Protein content ratio is A={ratioA}, B={ratioB}. Pack price does not carry that.
lp.how.afterSub: The lower unit price is product B
lp.how.afterNote: Product B costs {diff} more per pack, yet is about {percent} lower per gram of protein.

lp.foot.about: pergram is a calculator that ranks products by price per unit of active ingredient. It does not recommend specific products. Links to stores are affiliate links, but rank is determined by the price calculation alone.
lp.section5.heading: What this site does not do
lp.section5.item1: It does not describe what nutrients do in the body.
lp.section5.item2: It does not create an overall score, and it does not rank products as better or worse.
lp.section5.item3: Ranking is determined by the metric shown. Ad revenue does not affect it.
lp.section5.item4: It does not store age, sex, or health information.
